title: Existence of a balanced subtree
statement:
Let $t$ be a binary tree, and write $\ell(t)$ for its number of leaves. Let $n$ be a natural number with $n > 1$, and suppose that $3\,\ell(t) \ge 2n$. Then $t$ has a subtree $s$ whose number of leaves satisfies
\[
n \le 3\,\ell(s) < 2n.
\]
hypotheses_covered: n is a natural number with n > 1
3 times the number of leaves of t is at least 2n
replaced:
Let $t$ be a binary tree and $n$ a natural number with $n > 1$ and
$3 \cdot \lvert t \rvert \ge 2n$, where $\lvert t \rvert$ denotes the number of leaves
of $t$.  Then there exists a subtree $s$ of $t$ such that
$n \le 3\lvert s \rvert < 2n$.
